summary: The diff implements fixes for both REQ-1 (Products page regression) and REQ-2 (Admin login regression). ProductGrid.tsx is restored with full filtering, pagination, and backend fetching. AdminLogin.tsx, AdminPage.tsx, AdminPanel.tsx, useAuth.ts, useBackendAuth.ts, and useQueries.ts are all updated to support both custom auth and Internet Identity login flows with session persistence and proper logout. The implementation appears comprehensive and aligned with both requirements.
